**Issue #2682 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #2682: Patch: Back closes the home screen's Quests scroll, the match's modifier list and the emote menus, as it closes every other sheet
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
On a phone, the back gesture is how most people close things, and today it closes nearly every sheet and dialog in JackiOh. Three small panels still ignore it: the quests scroll on the home screen, the list of active modifiers opened from a match's controls, and the emote menu that hangs off a hero portrait. With one of them open, Back leaves the home screen, or in an online match asks whether you want to leave the game, while the panel stays where it was. Once built, Back closes the panel first, as it already closes the Marketplace, the deck builder's pickers and a card's view.

## Why
- R2127000 (`spec/rulings/R2127000.md`, §10.10): Back closes the topmost sheet or dialog a player dismisses before it leaves the screen. Its “Which” list names every overlay it covers; #2563 and #2604 added the ones that had been missed.
- Three dismissable overlays close on Escape and on an outside press, but never on Back, and none of their files mounts `BackLayer` or `useBackLayer` (`apps/web/src/net/backLayers.ts:180`, `:202`):
  - the home screen's Quests scroll, `QuestsBookmark` (`apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx:359-377`, its panel at `:410-421`);
  - the modifier list's panel (`apps/web/src/game/ModifierList.tsx:40-56`), mounted in practice, lessons, the online match, Duos, watching and replays;
  - the emote picker and the opponent's mute menu (`useMenuLifetime`, `apps/web/src/emotes/ui.tsx:53-73`, used at `:136` and `:227`).
- The siblings do it: `game/deckbuilder/DeckHistory.tsx:188`, `game/Marketplace.tsx:170`, `emotes/PortraitPicker.tsx:169`.
- In a live online match a Back with no layer open meets the leave guard (R1754000), so a player who opens the emote menu and swipes back is asked whether to leave the game, with the menu still open behind the question.

## Proposal
- Mount a Back layer while each is open, closing through its own close, as R2127000's How asks:
  - Quests: `close`, then the focus back on the bookmark, as its Escape does;
  - the modifier list: `setOpen(false)`;
  - the emote menus: `onClose`, only when not `inline` (inside the hero's inspect view, that view's own layer owns the menu).
- Escape keeps each panel's own handler, so one Escape never closes two things.
- Edit R2127000 in place: add the three to “Which”, cite this issue in `cards`, and list the new tests' files in `proven_in`.

## Where it lands
- `apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/ModifierList.tsx`, `apps/web/src/emotes/ui.tsx`
- Tests: `apps/web/src/routes/landing-quests.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/ModifierList.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/emotes/ui.test.tsx`
- `spec/rulings/R2127000.md`; SPEC §10.10

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] With the Quests scroll open, Back closes it, leaves the address and the screen as they were, and puts the focus on the bookmark; a second Back leaves the screen as before.
- [ ] With the modifier list open, Back closes it and nothing else.
- [ ] With the emote picker or the mute menu open in a live match, Back closes the menu and the leave question does not appear; a second Back meets the leave guard as before.
- [ ] An emote menu drawn inline in the hero's inspect view adds no layer of its own.
- [ ] Each case is an `R2127000` test in the files above, listed in the note's `proven_in`; `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test` on the touched files, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and eslint pass.

## Size and risks
Small: about three lines of component code each, plus three tests and the note's edit. Client only (CLAUDE.md rule 7). Risk: the emote menu's outside-press close and its layer must not both fire on one tap; the layer closes only on Back.

## Plan

_Written by `gpt` (codex, `gpt-5.6-sol`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41319887807)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Make browser/Android Back close the open home Quests scroll, active-modifier list, or portrait emote/mute menu before navigating or invoking a live match's leave guard. Preserve each overlay's existing Escape/outside-press behavior, return Quests focus to its bookmark, and ensure inline hero-inspect emote menus rely only on the inspect view's Back layer.

## Files to touch

| Path | Kind | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/README.md` | change | Extend the R2127000 Back-layer component inventory with the three newly covered overlay families and the non-inline emote condition. |
| `apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx` | change | Mount `BackLayer` while `QuestsBookmark` is open and close/focus through its existing bookmark behavior. |
| `apps/web/src/routes/landing-quests.test.tsx` | change | Add the R2127000 Back/history/focus regression for the Quests scroll. |
| `apps/web/src/game/ModifierList.tsx` | change | Mount `BackLayer` with the portaled modifier panel and close it with `setOpen(false)`. |
| `apps/web/src/game/ModifierList.test.tsx` | change | Add the R2127000 Back/history regression for the modifier list. |
| `apps/web/src/emotes/ui.tsx` | change | Give non-inline `EmoteMenu` and `MuteMenu` a `BackLayer` that calls `onClose`; inline menus get none. |
| `apps/web/src/emotes/ui.test.tsx` | change | Add R2127000 picker, mute-menu, leave-guard, and inline-no-layer regressions. |
| `spec/rulings/R2127000.md` | change | Cite issue #2682, add the three overlay families and inline exception to the ruling, and list all three proving test files. |

Do not touch `apps/web/src/net/backLayers.ts`, CSS, `spec/10-engine-guide.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/pending/`, generated wire files, manifests/lockfiles, or any Rust crate. SPEC §10.10 and R2127000 govern Back behavior; R1754000 governs the live-match leave guard, while R2035000, R169, R643, and R1330 govern the existing Quests, modifier, emote, and inline-inspect behavior.

## Steps

1. In `apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx`, import `BackLayer` from `../net/backLayers.ts`. In `QuestsBookmark`, render `<BackLayer>` only when `open` (`phase === "open"`), not during `closing`; its `onClose` must call the existing `close()` and then `bookmark.current?.focus()`, exactly matching the Escape path without moving Escape handling into the shared layer.
2. In `apps/web/src/routes/landing-quests.test.tsx`, import `pressBack`. Add `it("R2127000 Back rolls up the open Quests scroll, keeps the home screen and address, restores bookmark focus, and a second Back leaves", ...)`: call `at("/play")`, `window.history.pushState(null, "", "/")`, `signIn()`, `serve([book()])`, and `render(<LandingRoute />)`; await the quest count, open the panel, move focus to the Play link, and press Back. Assert the bookmark is collapsed and focused, the panel is closing, the landing root and `/` remain, and then assert a second Back reaches `/play`. Keep real timers because `pressBack` depends on queued history tasks.
3. In `apps/web/src/game/ModifierList.tsx`, import `BackLayer` from `../net/backLayers.ts`. Place `<BackLayer onClose={() => setOpen(false)} />` inside the portaled panel so it exists exactly while `open` is true; retain the component's own Escape and outside-pointer listeners unchanged.
4. In `apps/web/src/game/ModifierList.test.tsx`, import `pressBack` and `at`. Add `it("R2127000 Back closes the open modifier list and nothing else; a second Back leaves", ...)`: call `at("/play")`, `window.history.pushState(null, "", "/practice")`, render `<ModifierList view={fullBoardView()} opponentLabel="AI" />`, open it through `modifierListTestid.chip`, press Back, and assert the panel is gone, the chip has `aria-expanded="false"`, and the address is still `/practice`; press Back again and assert `/play`.
5. In `apps/web/src/emotes/ui.tsx`, import `BackLayer` from `../net/backLayers.ts`. As the first child of both `EmoteMenu` and `MuteMenu`, render `<BackLayer onClose={onClose} />` only when `inline` is false. Leave `useMenuLifetime(!inline, ...)`, the outside-pointer/Escape listeners, event propagation guards, and `useKeepOnScreen` unchanged so Back alone uses the new layer and hero-inspect menus remain owned by the inspect overlay.
6. In `apps/web/src/emotes/ui.test.tsx`, import `useState` and `ReactElement`, plus `guardLeaving`, `paths`, `usePathname`, `pressBack`, and `at`. Add `function Path(): ReactElement` to render `usePathname()` (installing `navigate.ts`'s pop listener); add `type MenuKind = "picker" | "mute"` and `function MenuHost({ kind, onClose }: { kind: MenuKind; onClose: () => void }): ReactElement`, whose local `open` state closes with `setOpen(false)` and then forwards `onClose`, which always renders `Path`, and which selects `<EmoteMenu side="you" hand={HAND} gate={() => OPEN} onPick={noop} ... />` or `<MuteMenu muted={false} onMute={noop} ... />`; add `function arrive(): void` that calls `at("/decks")` and `window.history.pushState(null, "", paths.match("m1"))`.
   - Add `it("R2127000 Back closes the emote picker before the live-match leave guard, and a second Back meets it", ...)` and `it("R2127000 Back closes the Mute menu before the live-match leave guard, and a second Back meets it", ...)`. In each, register `guardLeaving`, render `MenuHost`, press Back, and assert one close, no held leave, no menu, and the match address; press Back again and assert one held leave and the restored match address. Release the guard in `finally`.
   - Add `it("R2127000 inline hero-inspect emote menus add no Back layer of their own", ...)`: render both menu types with `inline` and close spies plus `Path` on the guarded match address, press Back once, and assert neither closes, both remain, and the guard receives the leave. This directly proves neither inline component intercepts Back; release the guard in `finally`.
7. In `apps/web/README.md`, extend **Back closes the top overlay** so its explicit callers include `QuestsBookmark`, `ModifierList`, and non-inline `EmoteMenu`/`MuteMenu`, all closing through their own callbacks.
8. In `spec/rulings/R2127000.md`, append `issue #2682` to `cards`; append `apps/web/src/routes/landing-quests.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/ModifierList.test.tsx`, and `apps/web/src/emotes/ui.test.tsx` to `proven_in`. In **Which**, add the home Quests scroll, the game board's active-modifier list (covering practice, lessons, online, Duos, watch, and replay because they share `ModifierList`), and the portrait emote picker/opponent mute menu as issue #2682 additions. State that their inline hero-inspect versions add no layer because hero inspect owns their lifetime. Do not create a new ruling or pending note and do not edit the generic §10.10 paragraph.

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/routes/landing-quests.test.tsx`: `R2127000 Back rolls up the open Quests scroll, keeps the home screen and address, restores bookmark focus, and a second Back leaves` proves close animation state, focus, first-Back address stability, and normal second-Back navigation.
- `apps/web/src/game/ModifierList.test.tsx`: `R2127000 Back closes the open modifier list and nothing else; a second Back leaves` proves the portaled list consumes exactly one Back.
- `apps/web/src/emotes/ui.test.tsx`: `R2127000 Back closes the emote picker before the live-match leave guard, and a second Back meets it` and `R2127000 Back closes the Mute menu before the live-match leave guard, and a second Back meets it` prove both portrait menus close before R1754000 and the next Back reaches it; `R2127000 inline hero-inspect emote menus add no Back layer of their own` proves both inline variants bypass the layer stack.

Run exactly:

```sh
pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/landing-quests.test.tsx
pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/ModifierList.test.tsx
pnpm --dir apps/web test src/emotes/ui.test.tsx
pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck
pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx apps/web/src/routes/landing-quests.test.tsx apps/web/src/game/ModifierList.tsx apps/web/src/game/ModifierList.test.tsx apps/web/src/emotes/ui.tsx apps/web/src/emotes/ui.test.tsx
cargo jackioh spec check
cargo fmt --check
cargo jackioh catalog check
cargo jackioh patches check
```

## Done when

- [ ] One Back closes each newly covered overlay through its own close path without changing the current screen/address or invoking the leave guard.
- [ ] Quests Back restores bookmark focus; a second Back navigates normally.
- [ ] Modifier-list Back closes only the list, and its existing Escape/outside/chip closes still work.
- [ ] Both non-inline emote menus close before the live-match leave guard; the next Back meets the guard.
- [ ] Both inline hero-inspect emote menus add no layer.
- [ ] Every new proving test title contains `R2127000`, and all three files are in the ruling's `proven_in`.
- [ ] The three targeted Vitest files, web typecheck, targeted ESLint, spec check, rustfmt, catalog check, and patches check pass.
- [ ] `git diff` contains only the eight listed files and no generated or unrelated changes.

## Risks

- Mounting a layer during the Quests `closing` animation would consume an extra Back; gate it on `phase === "open"` only.
- A Back close must unmount its layer before the next history traversal; tests need stateful hosts, not bare `vi.fn()` callbacks that leave a menu mounted.
- Giving inline emote menus a layer would stack them above hero inspect and require an extra Back; condition the rendered `BackLayer`, not merely the outside/Escape hook.
- Keep outside-pointer and Escape handlers local so a tap cannot trigger both close mechanisms and one Escape cannot close two layers. This remains client presentation only: it changes no game rule, hidden information, deterministic state, replay, or crate contract.
- Update `apps/web/README.md` because its R2127000 paragraph explicitly inventories callers; leaving that list stale was rejected. Do not edit §10.10 because its generic Back requirement already covers these overlays.

## Open questions

None.
````
